_meta.coord_space: SVG y-down, sprites upright. Triangles share ONE space; use each model's fitted 'viewBox' to render framed, or 'globalBounds' for true relative sizes.
_meta.note: LIST `units` (117, every enemy); RENDER models[unit.model]; show unit stats. modelShared=true means several units share that body. triangles are flat [x1,y1,x2,y2,x3,y3]; fill each part with its color. Damage = base x crit x partMult x resist (PARAMETER_GLOSSARY sec.10). expectedMultRandom=area-weighted avg (unaimed); bestPart/bestMult=aimed. RASTER CAVEAT: staged idle PNGs are NOT pre-aligned to the polygon space (no pivot/PPU) — ship polygons only, or hand-align per model.
